player_prompt.intro:
Ũrĩ thiĩ Mastermind.
Ũrĩ na njĩra ya kũgundua msimbo wa tarakimu {code_length}, kila tarakimu kutoka 1 hadi {num_numbers}, {repeats}.
Katika jibu lako, unaweza kutoa dhana yako kwa mfumo ufuatao: '[2 1 4 5]'.
Baada ya kila dhana, utapokea maoni kwa njia ya vipande vyeusi na vyeupe.
Kipande cheusi kinamaanisha tarakimu sahihi katika nafasi sahihi, wakati kipande cheupe kinamaanisha tarakimu sahihi katika nafasi isiyo sahihi.
Ũna {max_turns} mizunguko ya kubahatisha msimbo.
player_prompt.with_repeats: no kũhoteke gũcokererũo nĩ ũndũ ũcio rĩngĩ

invalid_move.wrong_format: Ndwarĩ na namba cia marandĩkĩre iria ciatigĩtwo tũthũngũri.
invalid_move.not_integers: Maũndũ mothe marĩa mandĩkĩtwo no mũhaka makorũo marĩ namba njĩru.
invalid_move.wrong_length: Ũhoro ũcio wagĩrĩirũo gũkorũo na namba {code_length}.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Namba ciothe no mũhaka ikorũo irĩ gatagatĩ ka 1 na {num_numbers}.
invalid_move.repeated_guess: Nĩ ũhĩtĩte {guess}. Reke wĩgerie ũndũ ũngĩ ngũrani na ũcio.

game_action.feedback: Imetumwa [{guess}]. Maoni: {black_pegs} kipande cheusi (vipande), {white_pegs} kipande cheupe (vipande).

outcome.win: Ũmepasua msimbo, ukisuluhisha {black_pegs} kati ya {code_length} vipande kwa usahihi
outcome.turn_limit: Ũtaũri wa ũgarũrũku nĩ ũkinyĩte. Waguire {percent} gĩcunjĩ kĩa namba ũrĩa wagĩrĩire.
